name: shellox
description: Encrypted reverse shell with multi-session support. Encrypted communications and concurrent connection management with Tokio.

name: Fluxo
description: Decentralized crypto payment platform with multi-chain support — Ethereum, Solana, Polygon. Two custody models for merchants: hosted and self-custody. Think Stripe, but on-chain. Still in development.

name: Argus
description: OSINT platform for real-time monitoring of Telegram bots and chats. Multi-bot manager, Redis Pub/Sub + SSE for live streaming, JWT auth, and dockerized deployment.

name: TgCloud
description: Full-stack storage platform built on Telegram with a web frontend, JWT authentication, and an encrypted CLI for people who prefer not to use browsers for anything.

name: TgRAT
description: Multi-client Command & Control framework using Telegram as the communication layer. Encrypted communications throughout. Built for security research and to understand how these systems work from the inside out.

name: SBid POC
description: Found a real vulnerability in a live production system. Documented it, reported it to the maintainers through responsible disclosure, then published the proof of concept. The system has since been patched, as far as I know.

name: Hack The Box
description: Completed various machines across different difficulty levels. The interesting ones are the ones where the intended path isn't obvious until you've been staring at it long enough that something clicks.
